card.name: First digit before 00 or 0 endings
card.fires_on: A single leading digit, usually the 8 in 1-800 phone numbers, right before a following 0 or 00. Also the digit before 0 in round numbers like 30-day or U-50.

modes.label: Toll-free numbers
modes.description: The 8 after 1- in an 800 number for reporting side effects or poison control.
modes.example: You may report side effects to FDA at 1-<<8>>00-FDA-108

modes.label: Round numbers ending in 0
modes.description: A first digit before a trailing zero in a unit strength or cycle length.

card.plain: It marks the first digit of a number that is about to end in zero, mostly 1-800 phone numbers.
